source.method: centreline unwrap — body sampled perpendicular to the medial axis, then straightened

anchors.note: Pixel coordinate WITHIN each sprite that must sit exactly on the spline endpoint. Rotate the sprite to the local tangent about this point.

markings.renderOrder: above body rope, below head and tail

notes: body.png is SEAMLESS — the right edge cross-fades into the left. Tile or stretch freely.
body.png is CLEAN (no blotches) by design. All discrete markings are procedural stamps.
body.png spans the full texture height with zero vertical padding, as the rope maps texture height to rope width.
head.png and tail.png are cut from the ORIGINAL curved artwork, not unwrapped, so they stay undistorted.
